address: rue de la Lesse 61, Daverdisse, 6929, Belgium
bio: This former watermill is just the ticket to experience the beauty of the Ardennes countryside, starting with the view of the burbling river and garden. The characterful family-run inn, steeped in warm, friendly hospitality, is currently helmed by the son, who continues to uphold culinary traditions that have been going strong for several decades. For example, you may taste fillet of venison is paired with blackcurrant sauce and winter veggies or a refreshing dish of scallops flanked by a tangy dressing. The culinary score is entirely presented in set menus and the chef also reveals a weakness for plant-based recipes. Snug, yet spacious, well-equipped accommodation in the hotel for overnight or longer stays....
